point.title: 综合基础(be动词·指示代词·冠词·名词复数)
point.summary: be 动词随主语变化:I 用 am,单数用 is,复数或 you 用 are。指示代词:近指单数 this、复数 these,远指单数 that、复数 those。不定冠词:辅音音素前用 a,元音音素前用 an。名词复数:一般加 -s,以 s/x/ch/sh 结尾加 -es。There be 表存在:单数用 There is,复数用 There are。
point.examples: I am ready. / These are my books. / It's an orange. / There are three boxes.

questions.stem: I ____ a middle school student.
questions.explanation: 主语 I 用 be 动词 am。

questions.stem: This ____ my English teacher.
questions.explanation: 单数主语用 is。

questions.stem: My parents ____ teachers.
questions.explanation: 复数主语用 are。

questions.stem: You ____ my good friend.
questions.explanation: 主语 you 用 are。

questions.stem: ____ is my new schoolbag.
questions.explanation: 近指单数用 this。

questions.stem: ____ are my classmates.
questions.explanation: 近指复数用 these。

questions.stem: Look at ____ bird in the tree over there.
questions.explanation: 远处的单只鸟,远指单数用 that。

questions.stem: This is ____ apple.
questions.explanation: 元音音素开头的 apple 前用 an。

questions.stem: I have ____ new bike.
questions.explanation: 辅音音素开头的 new 前用 a。

questions.stem: There are three ____ on the desk.
questions.explanation: 可数名词复数一般加 -s。

questions.stem: I can see two ____ in the room.
questions.explanation: 以 x 结尾的名词复数加 -es。

questions.stem: ____ some students in the classroom.
questions.explanation: 复数 students 用 There are 表存在。

questions.stem: ____ those your books on the floor? Yes, ____ are.
questions.explanation: 复数主语 those 用 are;简答用复数代词 they。

questions.stem: This is not a pen. It's ____ eraser.
questions.explanation: 元音音素开头的 eraser 前用 an。

questions.stem: My father and mother ____ doctors.
questions.explanation: and 连接的复数主语用 are。

questions.stem: There are many ____ in my school.
questions.explanation: 以 s 结尾的名词复数加 -es。

questions.stem: ____ a big tree near my school.
questions.explanation: 单数 a big tree 用 There is 表存在。

questions.stem: Kate and I ____ in the same class.
questions.explanation: Kate and I 是复数,用 are。

questions.stem: This is ____ egg and ____ old box, not ____ new bag.
questions.explanation: egg、old 以元音音素开头用 an;new 以辅音音素开头用 a。

questions.stem: ____ that boy your brother? No, ____ isn't.
questions.explanation: 单数主语 that boy 用 is;指男孩用主格 he。
